　　しつようなてきの　おってから　にげつづけていた‥‥
en:
In a world far, far away...
the peace that had long endured has now come to an end.
The Emperor of Palamecia summoned monsters from
the Demon World and set out to conquer the world.

Against this, the rebel army rose up in the Kingdom of Finn
but, met with the Empire's all-out attack,
it lost its castle and was forced to retreat
to the remote town of Altea.

Four young people living here in the Kingdom of Finn
also lost their parents to the enemy's attack
and kept fleeing from their relentless pursuers...
